Mission Local reported that Mayor Daniel Lurie accepted an amendment exempting buildings with three or more rent-controlled apartments from his upzoning plan. The newsroom estimated the change would cover at least 84,000 rental units in 11,700 buildings, while two-unit buildings remained included in the plan.
